h2. Description

The *display switcher and the density button should use the design's thin outline icons*, with a different density drawing in Board View than in Tech View. On staging the drawings differ.

For example,
* the List icon is a boxed list, not a bulleted list; the person and board icons are heavier than the design's thin outline icons
* the density button shows the up-and-down arrow on the left of the three lines; the design has it on the right
* Board View's density button shows the same drawing as Tech View's; the design gives Board View a card with an up-and-down arrow

This appears inconsistent with the requirement defined in *Epic SV-10043* (Story *SV-10044*), the PRD and the design.

h2. Steps to Reproduce

# Sign in to staging as an Admin, check the top bar shows *Staging Heavy Duty - 9919*, and use a browser window 1440 px wide at 100% zoom.
# Open *Work Orders*, click the *All* tab, then *Tech View* in the display switcher (right side of the toolbar).
#* Look at the switcher and the density button and compare them with the design pictures.
# Click *Board View* in the display switcher.
#* The density button shows the same drawing as in Tech View.

*Actual Result:*
* The switcher icons and the density icon are not the design's drawings; Board View reuses Tech View's density icon.

*Expected Result:*
* The switcher and density button use the design's icons, as the test expects: *"Step 10: the Board View button is now the white raised segment, and the density button shows a different drawing from Tech View's: a card with an up-and-down arrow (the design's "card-height" icon), as in the Board View picture."*
